packageRules.description: A library's go directive is every consumer's minimum Go. Propose only versions that build on the one go.mod declares, so an upgrade never raises it as a side effect of go mod tidy. A security fix is exempt (vulnerabilityAlerts below): one that needs a newer Go is proposed rather than dropped, and the raise is reviewed with it.

go-webauthn is pinned exactly and upgraded by hand after its changelog is read: an upgrade waits for approval on the dependency dashboard. A security fix still opens a pull request at once: vulnerabilityAlerts sets dependencyDashboardApproval to false.
examples/sqlitestore requires this module and replaces it with the tree it sits in; the version in its require line is never used, so it is not updated.
